'''Sato''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]] she was stationed in [[Republic Power Generation]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where she was killed protecting a Republic power generator.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Sato appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Nar Shaddaa.
